title.rendered: Nothing Can Separate You from His Love: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: Nothing can separate you from the love of God in Christ Jesus. Not death, not life, not angels, not demons, not the present, not the future. Paul has looked at every threatening reality and dismissed every one. His love holds.

content.rendered:
The Gospel For Today | Sunday, May 10, 2026

Today’s Scripture

“For I am convinced that neither death nor life, neither angels nor demons, neither the present nor the future, nor any powers, neither height nor depth, nor anything else in all creation, will be able to separate us from the love of God that is in Christ Jesus our Lord.”
Romans 8:38-39 (NIV) | ESV

Today’s Message

Paul does not end Romans 8 with a question. He ends it with a declaration. And it is one of the most sweeping declarations in all of Scripture. He does not say probably nothing can separate you. He does not say almost nothing. He says nothing. Not death. Not life. Not angels. Not demons. Not the present. Not the future. Not height nor depth. Not anything else in all creation.

He has looked at every category of threatening reality he can think of, lined them all up, and dismissed every one of them as insufficient to break what God has established between you and Him through Jesus Christ. The love of God is not a fragile thing that circumstances can erode. It is not a relationship that your failures can terminate. It is settled, secure, and eternal, held in place not by your grip on God but by His grip on you.

This is what the whole of Romans 8 has been building to. We began this week with no condemnation in Romans 8:1. We close it here with nothing separating us from His love. The chapter that began by removing the fear of judgment ends by removing the fear of abandonment. Both fears are answered in the same person: Jesus Christ our Lord.

Whatever you are carrying into this day, whatever has happened this week, whatever shame or fear or confusion has been whispering that God has moved away from you, this verse is your answer. He has not moved. He cannot be moved. And nothing you have done or will do can reach far enough to push you outside the circle of His love.

Prayer

Father, I receive this truth today. Nothing separates me from Your love. Not my past, not my weakness, not my failures, not my fears. You have settled this in Christ and it cannot be undone. I stand in that security today, not because I earned it but because You declared it. Thank You. In Jesus name. Amen.

Declaration

Nothing in all creation can separate me from the love of God in Christ Jesus my Lord. Not death, not life, not angels, not demons, not the present, not the future. I am held by a love that does not fail, does not change and does not let go. I live today from that secure place.
